_doc: PLAN.md 8.3, `[D4]`: WaveTime's arcade power-ups. A destroyed enemy drops one with drop_chance (a separate roll from its loot; 0.08 felt slow on the phone, owner 2026-10-31), picked by weight. While it lasts, every gun fires `shots` times as many shots, fanned spread_deg apart (a beam hits that many times as hard). They exist only inside a run: never banked, never in the hangar, never in Creative or Story. A new one replaces the one running.
